steps.text: Talk to the Boy in Taverley to start the quest.
choices: Ok, I'll see what I can do.

steps.text: Look under the potted plant just outside the witch's house for the house key.
Go down the ladder to the basement.
Go through the gate whilst wearing gloves. If you don't have gloves, search the nearby boxes until you get a pair.
Open the cupboard and get a magnet from it
Open the cupboard and get a magnet from it
Use the cheese on the mouse hole in the south room, then use the magnet on the mouse which emerges.
Pick up the witch's diary from the table and read it to ensure the door stays unlocked. Check the "Checkpoint" section if you want to skip this step.
Enter the garden and sneak around the perimeter to search the fountain. If the witch spots you, you'll be teleported outside.
Use the shed key on the shed door to enter.
Enter the shed. If the door doesn't open, you need to get the shed key from the fountain again.
If an experiment hasn't spawned, attempt to pick up the ball once.
Kill all four forms of the Witch's experiment (levels 19, 30, 42, and 53). You can safe spot the last two forms from the crate in the south of the room.
Return the ball to the boy. Make sure the witch doesn't spot you or you'll have to get the ball back again..
